stemMd: In context, translate directly into most nearly means what?
explanationMd: Officials assume roof-temperature reductions will yield corresponding electricity reductions. Translate is figurative here, describing an expected link between outcomes rather than linguistic conversion.

distractorRationale.a: The phrase concerns physical and practical effects.
distractorRationale.e: Temperature and electricity use have different units.
distractorRationale.d: The issue is causal correspondence, not merely timing.
